text: 3.1 Hello there, I wonder if you can help me. I'm thinking of going sightseeing somewhere today Can you recommend anywhere good to go? Well, it depends on what you like There are lots of places to choose from what kinds of things are you interested in? I don't know Something cultural. All right. Okay Well, quite close to here is St Mary's Church. It's Krakow's most famous church and very beautifully decorated. You can walk there in five or ten minutes. OK. I'm not really a big fan of churches, to be honest. That's OK, I understand. Of course, the most visited place near here is Auschwitz. There's a day tour leaving soon. Actually, we're planning on going there later in the week. Well, in that case you could try Kazimierz, the old Jewish quarter, where Steven Spielberg filmed some of Schindler's List. It's actually quite a lively area now. There are lots of good bars and restaurants around there. Oh, so that might be nice for this evening then. Yes, maybe. Let me know if you want more information about places to eat or drink there. Umm... then if you'd prefer something a bit different, how about a guided tour of Novahutta, the old communist district? They'll show you what life was like in the old days there. Oh, that sounds interesting. How much is that? About 40 euros. I can call and book a place for you if you want. What time does that leave? Every two hours from outside the hotel and the tours last around 90 minutes They leave at 10 o'clock 12 o'clock 2 o'clock and 4 o'clock. Okay, that's great Can you book me on to the 2 o'clock tour then I can do some shopping in the main square in town beforehand
